# Velytra

Velytra is a multisport training and coaching platform. This site presents the public brand, core product positioning, and launch information.

Languages:
- Català: `/ca/` (full V1)
- English: `/en/` (under construction)
- Español: `/es/` (under construction)

Key pages in Catalan:
- Home: `/ca/`
- Functionalities: `/ca/funcionalitats/`
- Athletes: `/ca/atletes/`
- Coaches: `/ca/entrenadors/`
- FAQ: `/ca/faq/`
- Download: `/ca/descarrega/`
- Contact: `/ca/contacte/`
- Privacy: `/ca/privacitat/`
- Terms: `/ca/termes/`
